content.hook_text: Read this if you feel unseen.
content.subtext: A verse for when you wonder if anyone notices
content.verse_text: She gave this name to the Lord who spoke to her: You are the God who sees me, for she said, I have now seen the One who sees me.
content.reflection: Hagar was invisible to everyone else. A servant, cast out, alone in the wilderness. Yet God found her. Not to correct her, but to see her. He gave her a promise and a future. If you feel overlooked today, remember: the God who sees Hagar sees you too. Your story matters to Him.
